statement: Amr ibn Salamah: the Arabs delayed their Islam until the conquest, saying if he prevailed over his people he was a true prophet; after the conquest every tribe hastened, and his father hastened with his people's Islam.
notes: Direct speech. Machine-checked for the opening; the quoted part is in the remainder, from memory.

statement: Year 9 was known as the Year of Delegations; delegations came from across Arabia.
Abu Raja al-Utaridi: we used to worship a stone and discard it when we found a better one.

The delegation of Abd al-Qays: 'welcome to the people, neither disgraced nor regretful'; they could come only in the sacred months; he commanded faith in Allah alone, prayer, zakah, and the fast of Ramadan.
notes: Direct speech. Machine-checked for the opening. The narration also commands giving the fifth of spoils and forbids four kinds of vessels; omitted.

statement: Abu Hurayrah: Thumamah ibn Uthal of Banu Hanifah was captured and tied to a pillar; asked three days running, he gave the same answer; the Prophet said 'release Thumamah'; he bathed, declared the shahadah, and said the Prophet's face had been the most hated and was now the most beloved to him.
notes: Direct speech. Machine-checked for the first part; the remainder from memory.

statement: Hudhayfah: al-Aqib and as-Sayyid of Najran came intending mutual imprecation; one dissuaded the other; they agreed to terms and asked for a trustworthy man; he sent Abu Ubaydah ibn al-Jarrah.
notes: Direct speech. Machine-checked. That they kept their religion under the terms is from the Seerah.

statement: They disputed about Isa; Qur'an 3:61 calls for mutual imprecation.
Abu Hurayrah: in the hajj led by Abu Bakr the year before the Farewell Hajj, he was sent to announce that no idolater would perform hajj after that year and none would circle the House naked.

His instructions to Mu'adh on sending him to Yemen: call them to the two testimonies, then five prayers, then alms from their rich to their poor; beware the supplication of the wronged, for there is no veil between it and Allah.
notes: Direct speech. Machine-checked for the first part. The expedition to Tabuk (year 9) is not covered in this series outline; flagged for the reviewer as a gap.
